title: Research: optimize observable connector repair across source changes (no new kappa)
body:
A common-B connector spanning a restored source-mutation tour can repair only the component visible to each current reader. The fixed seed-50 instance needs **four connector corrections instead of fourteen** for full coherence, or **three corrections** when one paid output repair is allowed. Including all source updates, both B calls, both reads per output and terminal restoration, the complete word falls **72 to 61 XORs**.

**Status: scoped recursive-interface construction, with no new kappa or selected-supplier adoption.**

The package adds a written observation contract and complete cost recurrence, exact mask planner, separate shortest-path oracle with locally checkable lower-bound potentials, literal words and tape accounting. The three-correction minimum is sharp in the declared correction alphabet. The same path minimizes the stated correction tariff for every positive block length. Opening and fusing the toy matrices costs only **26 XORs**; this explicit control excludes an unrestricted circuit-optimality claim.

Reproduce with Python 3.12 and standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/observable-connector-repair
```

Expected: `PASS_OBSERVABLE_CONNECTOR strict=4 mixed=3 coherent=14 complete_xors=72_to_61 small_cases=6220 controls=14 no_new_kappa`, five passing package tests, then `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Local validation passed on Python 3.12.13, with optimized direct replay on 3.14.6. Coverage includes 6,220 complete small demand/pricing cases, 648 literal forward/inverse basis-column cases, all 256 dirty inputs of a smaller batch, 5,696 observation checks, fourteen semantic/domain controls, source corruption rejection and read-only relocation. The selected-record integrity check passes unchanged. Physical hosting, instruction-tape admission, a contracting input-size recurrence, selected cold replay, formalization and independent human review remain separate.

Base and refreshed main: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`. Assignment seed **50**; recursive interfaces. [Claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1501). Final overlap inventory covers 762 open PRs and 196 discussion records; limits and exact heads are retained in `OVERLAP.json`.

Credit woklerx #1439 for full-coherence source repair, mightyOil #1203 for reader kernels, Hanson Sun #1246 for paid output defects, Sagar Thakrar #1199/#1227, and Ross Richardson's universal-connector lineage. The three closest predecessor notes are pinned and retained unchanged. Concurrent #1506 changes B and source over characteristic zero while retaining full coherence; this package keeps B fixed and optimizes weaker observable intermediate states. No priority is claimed for the predecessor identities or dynamic programming.

Hanson Sun (@bbMisk), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, both implementations, verification and prose. Apache-2.0. Separate implementations were authored in the same AI-assisted session.
